title: Bound per-Site Multi-Site egress allowlists

opportunity.rootCause: Per-Site egress AllowedHosts, AllowedPorts, and AllowedSchemes had no cardinality limits in configuration or typed snapshot validation, although the values are persisted and expanded into runtime egress policies and cluster metadata.
opportunity.risk: Oversized egress arrays could increase persistence, policy evaluation, metadata, and activation work without a bounded per-Site contract.

implementation.behavior: Both IConfiguration and typed snapshot validation now reject oversized egress allowlists before persistence-backed activation or runtime policy generation.

red.result: failed 1/1 because neither validation path returned egress cardinality errors

verification.multiSiteRegression: passed 264/264 across 99 executable test classes; external PostgreSQL fault-injection and non-test filename placeholders were not executable suite classes

boundary: PostgreSQL-backed integration and live oversized egress persistence/activation were not run in this environment
Authenticated browser and published-EXE smoke were not run
Visual responsive, screen-reader, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode, and production certification remain unverified
